name: Palatino Core Mark I
description: Elegant design meets innovation with the Palatino armor from Quirinus Tech. This armor set masterfully mixes reinforced plating with patented new materials that are light-weight and flexible, yet rated to withstand heavy damage allowing the wearer to be fashionable, light on their feet, and able to withstand serious firepower. The Mark I variant is primarily icy white with blue and red highlights.
